cards.title: The Detail That Makes It Official
cards.instruction: Choose one tiny procedural detail—wording, order, timing, seating, or a mark—and treat it as the only source of legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This marriage certificate has the dot above the wrong letter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've been married twenty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Socially, certainly. Typographically, it's complicated.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have three children.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's correct it before they inherit the error.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This marriage certificate has the dot above the wrong letter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've been married twenty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twenty years together. But until that dot moves, this doesn't certify a marriage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then move it. Our anniversary party starts at seven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. But we'll need a wedding cake. This dot makes tonight our first day.
